title: Adding undo/redo-tracked state changes to NotebookScene
answers: How do I make a notebook property change undoable?
Why does my notebook edit not show up in undo/redo?
How to add a new NOTEBOOK_EDIT_KIND action
Pattern for recording history actions in Notebook scene
body: Fix pattern: to make a scene-level state change (e.g. tags) undoable, guard with an `isEqual(previous, next)` no-op check before recording, call `this.state.body.commitPendingEdits()` first so any in-progress coalescing cell edit lands as its own undo step underneath, then call `this.editHistory.execute({ label, kind, perform, undo })` with a kind from NOTEBOOK_EDIT_KIND. Constraints: without the no-op guard, re-setting the same value creates a spurious history entry; without commitPendingEdits() first, the new action interrupts/merges into an unrelated pending edit instead of stacking cleanly.
applies: public/app/features/notebook/scene — any new tracked/undoable state on NotebookScene.

Without the no-op guard, re-setting the same value creates spurious entries. Without commitPendingEdits(), the new action merges into an unrelated pending edit instead of stacking cleanly.
